description: This is a shell script intended to automate building, patching, cloning, and testing an embedded development project involving multiple repositories such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, and an application gateway component. It manages dependencies, repositories checkout, patch application, build configuration, installation, test execution, and coverage report generation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables strict error handling and unset variable detection for robustness.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Prints error messages to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if the script can run apt-get commands (i.e., has root or sudo access).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get commands in a non-interactive, automated manner.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails, but continues execution.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to run git commands non-interactively.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref/tag in an existing repository, fetching as necessary.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if missing, re-clones if forced, and checks out to a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository in a way that avoids reapplying if already applied.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has been configured by looking for CMakeCache.txt.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Simple heuristic to detect if installed artifacts of a component exist, used to skip rebuilds.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a cmake project, skipping if artifacts appear complete.
